q20970.en: When the traffic light is red, vehicles must stop.

explain.short: Red means stop: every vehicle waits until green.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'devono arrestarsi' (must stop) is exactly what red means.

sceneParams.caption: Red light: every vehicle stops

q20971.en: In vertical traffic lights the red light is at the top; in horizontal ones it is on the left.

explain.short: Red has a fixed place: top in a vertical light, left in a horizontal one. This helps you recognise it.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: Both parts are right: 'in alto' (top) for vertical, 'a sinistra' (left) for horizontal.

sceneParams.caption: Red: top (vertical), left (horizontal)
lines: Vertical light: red at the top
Horizontal light: red on the left

q20972.en: In a traffic light the red light can be bigger than the others.

explain.short: Red can be made bigger so drivers see it better. It is allowed.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'può' (can) only says it is possible, not that it is always bigger.

sceneParams.caption: Red may be bigger than the other lights

q20973.en: When the red light is on, you must stop before the stop line.

explain.short: With red you stop before the white stop line across your lane, not in the junction.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'prima della striscia' (before the line): do not stop on it or after it.

sceneParams.caption: Stop BEFORE the stop line

q20974.en: While the red light is on, vehicles must not cross the stop line.

explain.short: For all the time red is on, the stop line is the limit: you wait behind it.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'Durante il periodo' (during the whole time): until green comes.

sceneParams.caption: Red: do not cross the stop line

q20975.en: A red traffic light lets you turn right with care, giving way to pedestrians crossing the road.

explain.short: In Italy red means stop for every direction. There is no right turn on red.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'consente di svoltare a destra' (lets you turn right) is the trap: that is a rule from other countries, not Italy.

sceneParams.caption: No right turn on red in Italy

q20976.en: A red traffic light lets you move off slowly when the others get yellow.

explain.short: Your light is still red: you wait for YOUR green. The other lights do not concern you.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'quando appare il giallo per gli altri' (when others get yellow): only your own light counts.

sceneParams.caption: Wait for your own green

q20977.en: A red traffic light lets you enter the junction very carefully, as long as there are no other vehicles or pedestrians.

explain.short: Red is a stop even when the junction is empty. Care does not make it legal.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'a condizione che non ci siano altri veicoli' (provided nobody is there) does not change red.

sceneParams.caption: Red = stop, even if the junction is empty

q20978.en: A red traffic light lets you cross the junction, as long as it is clear.

explain.short: Red means stop, even if the junction is free. Wait for green.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'purché sia libero' (as long as it is clear) is the trap: red does not depend on traffic.

sceneParams.caption: Red = stop, even if the road is clear

keywords.en: as long as it is clear

q20979.en: A red traffic light obliges you to hurry to clear the junction quickly.

explain.short: Red means stop and wait, not hurry. The steady yellow is the light that asks you to clear the junction.
explain.rule: Red (rosso) = stop before the stop line and wait for green. No turning, no moving off, even if the junction looks empty.
explain.trap: 'obbliga ad affrettarsi' (obliges you to hurry): red asks you to stop, not to rush.

sceneParams.caption: Red = stop and wait, not hurry

q20980.en: When the green light shown is on, you may turn left, giving way to vehicles coming from the front.

explain.short: Green lets you turn left. Oncoming vehicles going straight or right pass first.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'dando la precedenza' (giving way) is right: turning left you let oncoming traffic go first.

sceneParams.caption: Green: turn left, give way to oncoming cars

q20981.en: When the green light shown is on, you may turn right.

explain.short: A normal green light is valid for every direction, so you may turn right.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'si può' (you may): it is allowed, not compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Green: you may turn right

q20982.en: When the green light shown is on, you may go straight on.

explain.short: Green lets you go in every direction, straight on included.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'si può' (you may) is correct: going straight is allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Green: you may go straight on

q20983.en: When the green light shown is on, you may enter the junction only if you are sure you can clear it before the red light comes on.

explain.short: Do not block the junction: enter on green only if there is room to leave it before red.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is right here: entering a junction you cannot leave is not allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Enter only if you can get out before red
lines: Only if you can clear the junction

keywords.en: being sure you can clear it

q20984.en: When the green light shown is on, you may cross the junction, using care.

explain.short: Green allows you to go, but you still drive with care: others may make mistakes.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'usando prudenza' (using care) is correct: green is not a free pass.

sceneParams.caption: Green: go, but with care

q20985.en: Approaching a traffic light that has been green for a long time, you must go on with care, ready to stop if the yellow comes on before you have entered the junction.

explain.short: A green that has been on a long time will soon turn yellow. Be ready to stop at yellow.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'pronti eventualmente a fermarsi' (ready to stop if needed) is the correct attitude.

sceneParams.caption: Old green: be ready to stop

q20986.en: Approaching a traffic light that has been green for a long time, you must speed up, with no need to look at the light.

explain.short: A long green may soon turn yellow: slow down a little and watch the light, never speed up blindly.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'occorre accelerare' (you must speed up) and 'senza... guardare' (without looking) are both wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Old green: watch the light, do not speed up
lines: Watch the light, do not rush

keywords.it: senza che vi sia necessità di guardare

q20987.en: When the green light shown is on, you may turn left, but only when the yellow comes on as well.

explain.short: Green alone already lets you turn left. Green and yellow are never on together.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'ma solo quando si accende anche la luce gialla' (only when yellow is also on) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Green alone: you may turn left

q20988.en: When the green light shown is on, the driver turning left has priority over vehicles coming from the front.

explain.short: It is the opposite: turning left on green, you give way to oncoming vehicles.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority) is wrong: the left-turner gives way.

sceneParams.caption: Turning left: oncoming cars go first

q20989.en: When the green light shown is on, you may turn only if the carriageway is divided into lanes.

explain.short: Green lets you turn on any road, with or without lanes.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'solo se' (only if) adds a condition that does not exist.

sceneParams.caption: Green: turning allowed on any road

q20990.en: When the green light shown is on, you must go straight on.

explain.short: A normal green allows every direction. It does not force you to go straight.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'si deve' (you must) is the trap: green allows, it does not oblige.

sceneParams.caption: Green: you may also turn

q20991.en: When the green light shown is on, you may go straight on, but you must give way to pedestrians.

explain.short: Going straight on green, the pedestrians crossing in front of you have red, so you do not give way to them.
explain.rule: Green (verde) = you may go straight, right or left, with care. Turning left, give way to oncoming traffic; enter only if you can clear the junction.
explain.trap: 'dando però la precedenza ai pedoni' (but giving way to pedestrians) is wrong when you go straight.

sceneParams.caption: Straight on green: pedestrians in front have red

keywords.it: dando però la precedenza ai pedoni

q20992.en: In the traffic lights shown, lit green arrows show the directions in which you may go.

explain.short: Each green arrow opens only its own direction: you may go where it points.
explain.rule: Arrow lights work only for the arrow's direction: green = go, red = do not go, steady yellow = clear or stop safely, flashing yellow = extra care.
explain.trap: 'verso le quali si può proseguire' (in which you may go) is the right meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Green arrow: you may go that way

q20993.en: In the traffic lights shown, lit red arrows mean you may not go in the directions shown.

explain.short: A red arrow is a red light for that direction only.
explain.rule: Arrow lights work only for the arrow's direction: green = go, red = do not go, steady yellow = clear or stop safely, flashing yellow = extra care.
explain.trap: 'non si può proseguire' (you may not go) is right: red arrow = stop for that way.

sceneParams.caption: Red arrow: do not go that way
lines: Red arrow = stop for that way

q20994.en: In the traffic lights shown, steady yellow arrows mean: clear the junction if you are already in it, or stop safely.

explain.short: A steady yellow arrow works like a steady yellow light, for that direction only.
explain.rule: Arrow lights work only for the arrow's direction: green = go, red = do not go, steady yellow = clear or stop safely, flashing yellow = extra care.
explain.trap: Both parts are correct: 'liberare l'incrocio' (clear the junction) or 'arrestarsi' (stop) safely.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow arrow: clear or stop safely
lines: Not yet in: stop if safe

q20995.en: In the traffic light shown, flashing yellow arrows mean you cross the junction with special care.

explain.short: A flashing yellow arrow is a warning: you may go that way, but carefully.
explain.rule: Arrow lights work only for the arrow's direction: green = go, red = do not go, steady yellow = clear or stop safely, flashing yellow = extra care.
explain.trap: 'lampeggianti' (flashing) is different from steady: flashing = go with care.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow arrow: go with extra care

q20996.en: In the traffic light shown, lit green arrows pointing up mean you may go in all directions.

explain.short: An arrow pointing up means straight on only. Turning needs its own arrow.
explain.rule: Arrow lights work only for the arrow's direction: green = go, red = do not go, steady yellow = clear or stop safely, flashing yellow = extra care.
explain.trap: 'in tutte le direzioni' (in all directions) is wrong: up = straight only.

sceneParams.caption: Arrow up = straight on only

q20997.en: In the traffic light shown, lit red arrows mean you go on with care.

explain.short: A red arrow means stop for that direction, not go with care.
explain.rule: Arrow lights work only for the arrow's direction: green = go, red = do not go, steady yellow = clear or stop safely, flashing yellow = extra care.
explain.trap: 'proseguire con prudenza' (go on with care) is the meaning of flashing yellow, not red.

sceneParams.caption: Red arrow = stop for that way

q20998.en: The steady yellow light comes on as soon as the green goes off.

explain.short: The order is green, then yellow, then red. Yellow follows green straight away.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'appena si spegne il verde' (as soon as green goes off) is the correct order.

sceneParams.caption: Green off, then yellow on

keywords.en: as soon as green goes off

q20999.en: The steady yellow light goes off before the red comes on.

explain.short: Yellow and red are never on together: yellow ends, then red starts.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'prima che si accenda il rosso' (before red comes on) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow off, then red on

keywords.it: prima che si accenda il rosso

q21000.en: The steady yellow light obliges anyone already in the junction to clear it as soon as possible.

explain.short: If yellow comes when you are already in the junction, leave it quickly so it is free for the others.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'chi ha già impegnato l'incrocio' (who is already in the junction) is the key case.

sceneParams.caption: Already in the junction: clear it
lines: Do not stop in the middle

keywords.en: clear it as soon as possible

q21001.en: The steady yellow light obliges you to stop before the stop point, as long as you can do it without creating danger.

explain.short: At yellow you must stop if it is safe. If you are too close and braking is dangerous, you go on.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'purché lo si possa fare senza creare pericolo' (if safe) is the important condition.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow: stop if you can do it safely

q21002.en: The steady yellow light comes on when green and red are off.

explain.short: Yellow is always on alone: green has just gone off and red is not on yet.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'sono spenti' (are off): no other light is on with steady yellow.

sceneParams.caption: Steady yellow is always alone

keywords.it: il verde e il rosso sono spenti

q21003.en: The steady yellow light always lets you go on into the junction.

explain.short: Yellow means stop if you can do it safely. You go on only if you are too close to stop.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'in ogni caso' (in every case) is the trap: going on is only for when stopping is unsafe.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow: not a free pass
lines: Go on only if too close

q21004.en: The steady yellow light obliges the driver to go back if he has already passed the stop line.

explain.short: If you are past the line, you clear the junction. Going back would be dangerous.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'tornare indietro' (go back) is never what yellow asks.

sceneParams.caption: Past the line: clear the junction
lines: Past the line = go on and clear

q21005.en: The steady yellow light obliges us to stop in every case, without entering the junction.

explain.short: You stop at yellow only if you can do it safely. If you are too close, you go on.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'in ogni caso' (in every case) is wrong: stopping must be safe.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow: stop only if it is safe

q21006.en: The steady yellow light comes on while the red is still on.

explain.short: In Italy yellow comes after green, never together with red.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'quando è ancora accesa quella rossa' (while red is still on) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow comes after green, not with red

q21007.en: The steady yellow light goes off together with the green.

explain.short: Yellow comes on when green goes off, and goes off when red comes on.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'insieme con il verde' (together with green) is wrong: they are never on together.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow follows green

q21008.en: The steady yellow light comes on together with the red.

explain.short: Yellow is on alone, between green and red. It is never lit together with red.
explain.rule: Steady yellow (gialla fissa) comes alone, between green and red: stop if you can do it safely; if you are already in the junction, clear it.
explain.trap: 'insieme con il rosso' (together with red) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Yellow is never on with red

q21009.en: You can find the flashing yellow light when the other lights are off.

explain.short: Some traffic lights only flash yellow, for example at night, while red and green stay off.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'quando le altre sono spente' (when the others are off) is right: it flashes alone.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: others off

q21010.en: The round flashing yellow light (type A in the picture) is a general danger signal.

explain.short: Light A flashes yellow to warn of a danger in general: slow down and take care.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'pericolo generico' (general danger) is exactly its meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow = general danger

q21011.en: The round flashing yellow light (type A in the picture) asks you to reduce speed.

explain.short: It warns of danger, so you slow down.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'invita a moderare la velocità' (asks you to slow down) is right.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: slow down

q21012.en: The round flashing yellow light (type A in the picture) asks you to go on with special care.

explain.short: Flashing yellow does not stop you: you go on, but very carefully.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'procedere' (go on) is right: you go, you do not have to stop.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: go with extra care

q21013.en: In a traffic light, the flashing yellow light always makes you stop before the junction.

explain.short: Flashing yellow means care, not stop. You stop only if the priority rules require it.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'impone l'arresto sempre' (always makes you stop) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow: no compulsory stop

q21014.en: The round flashing yellow light (type A in the picture) can be placed before a movable bridge.

explain.short: Before a movable bridge you find two flashing RED lights, not a flashing yellow.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'ponte mobile' (movable bridge) belongs to the flashing red lights.

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge: flashing RED lights

q21015.en: The round flashing yellow light (type A in the picture) can be placed before a ferry boarding pier.

explain.short: At the entrance of a ferry pier you find flashing RED lights, not a flashing yellow.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'pontile d'imbarco' (ferry pier) belongs to the flashing red lights.

sceneParams.caption: Ferry pier: flashing RED lights

q21016.en: The flashing yellow light together with the red light shown indicates danger.

explain.short: Flashing yellow is never on together with red. When yellow flashes, the other lights are off.
explain.rule: Flashing yellow (gialla lampeggiante) = general danger: slow down and go with extra care. You do not have to stop.
explain.trap: 'insieme a quella rossa' (together with red) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing yellow is never on with red

q21017.en: The flashing red lights shown oblige you to stop at a railway level crossing without barriers.

explain.short: At a level crossing without barriers, these red lights flash when a train is coming: you must stop.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'senza barriere' (without barriers) is one of the places where these lights are used.

sceneParams.caption: Level crossing, no barriers: stop

q21018.en: The flashing red lights shown oblige you to stop at a railway level crossing with half-barriers.

explain.short: Level crossings with half-barriers also have these flashing red lights: you must stop.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'semibarriere' (half-barriers) is also correct: they close only half the road.

sceneParams.caption: Level crossing, half-barriers: stop

q21019.en: The flashing red lights shown oblige you to stop at the entrance of a ferry boarding pier.

explain.short: Ferry piers use these flashing red lights to stop traffic when boarding is closed.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'pontile d'imbarco' (boarding pier) is a correct place for these lights.

sceneParams.caption: Ferry pier: stop at flashing red

q21020.en: The flashing red lights shown oblige you to stop at the entrance of a movable bridge.

explain.short: When a movable bridge opens, these red lights flash and you must stop.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'ponte mobile' (movable bridge) is a correct place for these lights.

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge: stop at flashing red

q21021.en: The flashing red lights shown oblige you not to cross the stop line.

explain.short: Like a normal red, these lights mean you stay before the stop line.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'non superare' (not cross) is right: stop before the line.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing red: stay before the line

q21022.en: The flashing red lights shown are found near a police checkpoint.

explain.short: These lights are used at level crossings, movable bridges and ferry piers, not at police checkpoints.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco della polizia' (police checkpoint) is not one of their places.

sceneParams.caption: Not for police checkpoints

q21023.en: The flashing red lights shown oblige you to stop at the entrance of a narrow bridge.

explain.short: A narrow bridge has warning or priority signs, not these red lights. They are for movable bridges.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'ponte stretto' (narrow bridge) is the trap: the right word is 'ponte mobile' (movable bridge).

sceneParams.caption: Movable bridge yes, narrow bridge no

q21024.en: The flashing red lights shown indicate a compulsory exit from the motorway.

explain.short: These lights mean stop. A compulsory exit is shown with signs, not with these lights.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'uscita obbligatoria dall'autostrada' (compulsory motorway exit) has nothing to do with them.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing red = stop, not motorway exit

q21025.en: The flashing red lights shown are found 150 metres before a state border.

explain.short: These lights are not used at borders. They stand right at level crossings, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'confine di Stato' (state border) and '150 metri' are both invented here.

sceneParams.caption: Not used at state borders

q21026.en: The flashing red lights shown indicate that the green light is about to come on.

explain.short: Flashing red means stop. It does not announce green.
explain.rule: Flashing red lights = stop before the stop line. Used at level crossings without full barriers, movable bridges and ferry piers.
explain.trap: 'sta per accendersi la luce verde' (green is about to come on) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Flashing red = stop, not 'green soon'

keywords.it: sta per accendersi la luce verde
keywords.en: green is about to come on

q21027.en: The traffic light shown can have the white horizontal light on.

explain.short: In the public transport light, the white horizontal bar means stop.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'orizzontale' (horizontal) bar = stop for buses and trams.

sceneParams.caption: Horizontal white bar = stop

q21028.en: The traffic light shown can have the white vertical light on.

explain.short: In the public transport light, the white vertical bar means go.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'verticale' (vertical) bar = go for buses and trams.

sceneParams.caption: Vertical white bar = go

q21029.en: The light signal shown is a traffic light for public transport vehicles.

explain.short: White bars and a yellow triangle are used only for buses and trams.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'trasporto pubblico' (public transport) is right: other vehicles ignore it.

sceneParams.caption: Light for buses and trams only

q21030.en: The traffic light shown is a pedestrian light.

explain.short: Pedestrian lights show a walking person. This one, with white bars, is for buses and trams.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'pedonale' (for pedestrians) is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Not a pedestrian light

q21031.en: The traffic light shown warns of roadworks.

explain.short: This light gives stop and go orders to buses and trams. It has nothing to do with roadworks.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'lavori in corso' (roadworks) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Not a roadworks warning
lines: Buses and trams: stop or go

q21032.en: The traffic light shown indicates possible tram track switches.

explain.short: It tells buses and trams to stop or go. It does not show track switches.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'scambi dei binari' (track switches) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: Not for tram track switches
lines: Buses and trams: stop or go

q21033.en: The traffic light shown makes motorcycles slow down when the yellow triangle is on.

explain.short: This light is only for public transport. Motorcycles follow the normal traffic lights.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'ai motocicli' (to motorcycles) is wrong: it does not apply to them.

sceneParams.caption: Not for motorcycles

q21034.en: The traffic light shown applies to vehicles with military number plates.

explain.short: This light is for public transport vehicles, not for military vehicles.
explain.rule: White bars and yellow triangle = light for public transport only: horizontal bar stop, vertical bar go, triangle like yellow.
explain.trap: 'targa militare' (military plates) is the trap.

sceneParams.caption: Not for military vehicles
